rationale: C05 is a direct and material precursor: it assigns Gordon Gray the comprehensive foreign-economic-policy study whose completed report is the central input and framing device for the child's new assignment to Rockefeller. The child reuses C05's integrated conception of foreign economic policy, international development, governmental coordination, and private participation, then adapts that framework into instructions for the Advisory Board. C19 is also closely connected because it establishes that Board and its interagency machinery, but it is less likely than C05 to have supplied the letter's substantive drafting template. C23 has a parallel presidential assignment-letter structure, though mostly at a generic level.

shared_material.child_excerpt: On March 31, 1950, I requested Mr. Gordon Gray to undertake a comprehensive study of the foreign economic policies and procedures of this Government... Mr. Gray has now submitted his report.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have decided to appoint you as Special Assistant to the President to assist in this task... The first phase of our work is to determine the nature, dimensions, and significance of this problem.
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly invokes the earlier assignment and uses its resulting report as the basis for the new directive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: an effective program for international economic development must be integrated both as to policy and operations with all other governmental and private activities relating to the international trade and economic life of the nation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your principal role... will be to advise and assist in coordinating and stimulating the activities of the various Governmental agencies... I shall also look to you to obtain the views of experts and interested groups outside the Government
shared_material.explanation: Both directives use the same substantive model: coordinated government action combined with input and participation from private or nongovernmental actors.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You will wish to formulate your recommendations in the light of the Gray Report's comprehensive analysis of our entire foreign economic policy.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: we must develop the broad lines of policy... This approach must have as its final goal a practical and forward-looking course of action.
shared_material.explanation: The child's request for actionable recommendations carries forward the earlier letter's study-to-policy-to-action sequence.
